verdict.rationale: PII detection and redaction is a fair question for a browser-automation and scraping platform. However, the evidence pack documents no built-in feature that detects or filters personally identifiable information from scraped content before storage. Related features such as URL-to-markdown fetching, network interception, and file processing are adjacent building blocks, not PII filtering.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
